title: The casting door refuses a sorted berth fired for another ticket
intention: The casting door refuses a sorted berth that was fired for a different ticket, so a stale berth's answers never ride onto the ticket being cast. In cairn/tools/base/transitions.py _berth_lacks, when the sorted berth carries a title (top-level title or answers.title), refuse unless _slug of that title equals _slug of the doc's title, naming both titles in the lack. A berth with no title is still judged by workflow and node_class alone. Census 2026-10-18: across 560 tickets there are 430 distinct sorted berths; by slug, 317 of the 318 that carry a title agree with their ticket's title, and the one exception (548dd13fb4db) was renamed after its cast.
why: Law 7: a ticket is a record of truth, and a D1 seeded from another ticket's builder_check is a false record. Law 4: the binding between berth and ticket is now a reader's care, and this makes it the door's. Law 3: measured 2026-10-18, 05662f9e9bc9 was cast with 6c9db321d638's berth and carried its D1.

decisions.text:
D2 (supersedes D1, which pointed at a diff without carrying it): Only cairn/tools/base/transitions.py changes, inside _berth_lacks's isinstance(berth, dict) branch, right after the node_class check. Apply this unified diff verbatim (git apply):
diff --git a/cairn/tools/base/transitions.py b/cairn/tools/base/transitions.py
index af2983c1..28cc2725 100644
--- a/cairn/tools/base/transitions.py
+++ b/cairn/tools/base/transitions.py
@@ -2879,6 +2879,13 @@ def _berth_lacks(doc: dict) -> list[str]:
                 if ans.get("node_class") != doc.get("node_class"):
                     lacks.append("sorted_berth's answers.node_class differs from the doc's "
                                  "node_class")
+                # A berth carries the title it was fired under; bound by slug, as the filename is,
+                # so another ticket's berth is refused (c24c5310a727). A titleless berth is
+                # judged by workflow and node_class alone.
+                bt = berth.get("title") or ans.get("title")
+                if not _blank(bt) and _slug(str(bt)) != _slug(str(doc.get("title") or "")):
+                    lacks.append(f"sorted_berth was fired for {bt!r}, not for the doc's title "
+                                 f"{doc.get('title')!r}")
             elif berth is not None:
                 lacks.append(f"sorted_berth {sb!r} does not hold a JSON object")
     ib = doc.get("intent_berth")
The proof cairn/tools/base/proofs/test_a_cast_refuses_another_tickets_sorted_berth.py is committed red-first; edit nothing there.
